title: Annotrace: A Workbench for Step-Level Annotation of Agent Traces
abstract: arXiv:2610.23284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every study of why LLM agents fail begins by labelling traces by hand, and every such study builds its own throwaway tool. Observability platforms record agent traces but offer no structured labelling; annotation tools label text but have no notion of a step, a delegation or a tool call, leaving it unclear what the smallest unit of execution to label should be. Annotrace reads six trace formats, including OpenTelemetry GenAI, LangSmith and Langfuse, and turns each run into an ordered, nested list of steps. The annotator writes their own labelling codebook; a frontier model proposes a starting set from a sample of their own traces, answers first, and is asked exactly the questions the human is asked, making annotation a joint human-AI process. Annotrace measures agreement between any two annotators, human or AI. On a multi-agent question-answering corpus it reproduces a previous manual effort's 235 annotation units exactly, and two models

translated_title: Annotrace：一个用于智能体轨迹步骤级标注的工作台
translated_abstract: 每一项研究LLM智能体为何失败的工作，都始于对手工标注轨迹，而每一项这样的研究都会构建自己的一次性工具。可观测性平台能够记录智能体轨迹，却不提供结构化标注；标注工具可以标注文本，却没有“步骤”、任务“委派”或“工具调用”的概念，导致最小可标注的执行单元不明确。Annotrace 可以读取六种轨迹格式，包括 OpenTelemetry GenAI、LangSmith 和 Langfuse，并将每次运行转换为有序的、嵌套的步骤列表。标注者编写自己的标注手册；一个前沿模型会根据标注者自己轨迹的样本提出初始标注集，先行作答，并被问到与人类完全相同的问题，从而使标注成为一个人机协作的过程。Annotrace 能够衡量任意两个标注者（无论是人类还是AI）之间的一致性。在一个多智能体问答语料库上，它精确复现了此前一次人工标注工作的235个标注单元，并且两个模型……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Annotrace 是一个支持六种主流轨迹格式的智能体轨迹步骤级标注工作台，它将运行记录解析为有序嵌套的步骤，通过人机协作方式进行标注并衡量标注者间一致性，在多智能体问答语料上精确复现了此前人工标注的235个标注单元。
en_tdlr: Annotrace is a workbench for step-level annotation of agent traces that parses six trace formats into ordered nested steps, enables joint human-AI labelling with a frontier model answering the same questions as humans, measures inter-annotator agreement, and exactly reproduces a prior manual effort's 235 annotation units on a multi-agent QA corpus.
